title: A question about the experiment in the paper
body: Are the models experimented with in your paper all pre-trained, or are they fine-tuned using the training set portion of your dataset?
author: xuliu-cyber

comments.body: 另外，请问OpenFly的训练成本是多大呢？
The models are fine-tuned using training set portion of our dataset. Our training configuration is 8 A100 80G , and one epoch takes about half a day.

title: Will the environment scenes be opened?
body: Thanks for your great work and the shared data! I wonder will the environment scenes be opened?
author: xuliu-cyber

comments.body: Thank you for your attention. Of course, we are currently organizing the simulation environment and model training codes, which will be released later.

title: Thesis data question
body: Thank you for making this excellent work, please ask if it is possible to follow up with open source data
author: Daydaylight

comments.body: The dataset will be uploaded to the Opendatalab platform this week. The speed of the HuggingFace platform is slow, so it may take some time.

title: Time for Code Release
body: Thank you for your excellent work. May I ask when the code will be released?
